title: Consumer and producer duality
status: Original mathematically audited blueprint; no manuscript written or accepted. V12 final package retains production priority.
prerequisite: v13-c01, supported by acceptedv02c09 separation andv05c02/c03 elementary dual methods; canonical acceptance follows C01.
instructional_objective: Prove dual identities with their actual domains, diagnose admissibility of smooth demand/cost/profit functions, and distinguish differentiability/convex reconstruction from claims about unsupported technologies.

proof_contracts.claim: Positive-price existence and exact consumer duality
proof_contracts.proof: For continuous u on R_+^L, positive p, m>=0, compact budgets attain v. For an attainable target ubar>=u(0), a feasible witness bounds expenditure minimizers inside a compact positive-price sublevel; closed upper contour gives attainment. No-excess follows by a continuous radial path from0. Under LNS, cheaper attainment of v would leave room for a strict improvement; hence e(p,v(p,m))=m and both correspondence identities. For v(p,e)=ubar, a strictly better bundle could be scaled slightly down to beat the minimum. Unattainable targets and targets belowu(0) are excluded explicitly.

proof_contracts.claim: Price envelopes and Roy without unjustified division
proof_contracts.proof: At fixed attainable target, e is an infimum of linear price functions, hence concave, homogeneous1 and monotone; any minimizing h is a supporting supergradient. Under uniqueness at p, positive prices bound nearby optimizers; their subsequential limits minimize at p, hence converge to h. Two optimality inequalities sandwich e(p+dp)-e(p) between dp.h(p+dp) and dp.h(p), proving differentiability with gradient h. For differentiable v, any demanded x stays feasible along (p+td,m+t d.x); both signs of t imply v_p=-v_m x. Divide only when v_m>0. With nonunique Hicksian demand, prove the directional derivative min_{h in H}d.h under the same local compactness.

proof_contracts.claim: Smooth Slutsky restrictions and a precise integrability boundary
proof_contracts.proof: Differentiate h(p,u)=x(p,e(p,u)): S_ij=partial x_i/partial p_j+(partial x_i/partial m)x_j. Since h=gradient_p e, C1 h gives symmetric negative-semidefinite S; homogeneity gives Sp=0, and symmetry gives p^TS=0. These necessary restrictions do not follow from budget balance, homogeneity or own-price signs alone. Do not claim a general global Marshallian integrability theorem from pointwise restrictions.

proof_contracts.claim: Constructive sufficient integrability for a specified homothetic class
proof_contracts.proof: Let c be positive C1, concave and homogeneous1 on all strictly positive prices with gradient c>=0. Define U(x)=inf_{q>>0}q.x/c(q) for x>=0. It is finite nonnegative, concave, monotone and homogeneous1; no unproved global boundary-continuity theorem is needed. Euler and concavity give q.gradient c(p)>=c(q). Hence x=ubar gradient c(p) attains U=ubar, and every U>=ubar bundle costs at least ubar c(p). Thus e(p,ubar)=ubar c(p), h contains ubar gradient c(p), v=m/c(p) and this constructed demand is m gradient c(p)/c(p). Give the explicit example whose full Hicksian solution is unique; do not assert uniqueness for arbitrary c without proof.

proof_contracts.claim: Producer duality and correct envelope signs
proof_contracts.proof: Profit is a supremum of linear functions over a price-independent production set, hence convex and homogeneous1 where finite; two optimality inequalities give a nonnegative supply monotonicity inner product. Under local bounded attained choices and uniqueness, the same sandwich gives gradient profit=net supply. Conditional cost is an infimum of input-price linear functions, hence concave and homogeneous1, with positive factor-demand derivatives when differentiable. Smooth profit Hessian is symmetric PSD and annihilates the full price vector; cost price Hessian is NSD. Derive output convexity only under an appropriate convex/concave technology, not from price concavity.

For a compact nonempty generating set K, Y=co(K)-R_+^L is closed convex and free-disposal. It equals the intersection p.y<=max_K p.k for all p>>0: strict separation supplies a nonnegative normal (free disposal forbids negative components); add epsilon times the all-ones vector, use bounded K and a sufficiently small epsilon to preserve the strict violation. For a possibly nonconvex K-R_+^L, linear support values are unchanged by closed convexification and cannot recover the missing feasible combinations. Explicitly distinguish value equality from equality of supply correspondences at a tie.

worked_cases.name: Subsistence, compensated derivatives and two money metrics
worked_cases.model: X=(1,2)+R_+^2, u=sqrt((x1-1)(x2-2)), p>>0, m>=p1+2p2. Declare this shifted consumption domain separately from P1. e=p1+2p2+2u sqrt(p1p2); x=gamma+(m-p.gamma)(1/(2p1),1/(2p2)); h=gamma+u(sqrt(p2/p1),sqrt(p1/p2)). Prove global optima by AM-GM, including zero surplus.
worked_cases.lesson: Marshallian cross effects differ; compensated effects are symmetric, NSD and annihilate p. State welfare-loss sign conventions.

worked_cases.name: A kink and a zero derivative are different envelope boundaries
models: u=x1+2x2, target6, p=(2,4): e=6min(p1,p2/2)=12, H={x>=0:x1+2x2=6}; price1 one-sided slopes6 from left and0 from right. Directional derivative=min(6d1,3d2).

Separate u=(x1+x2-3)^3, p=(1,2), m=3. Unique demand(3,0); on p1<p2, v=(m/p1-3)^3. All Roy numerator/denominator derivatives vanish at this point though preferences strictly increase in total goods. Original total-goods index supplies a valid nonzero-denominator Roy representation.
worked_cases.lesson: Correspondences and directional envelopes remain meaningful at price kinks; ordinal utility changes can destroy a derivative ratio while preserving demand.

worked_cases.name: A plausible smooth demand system fails integrability
worked_cases.model: On a scale-invariant neighborhood of equal positive prices where all shares are positive, s_i=1/3+(1/12)(log(p_{i+1})-log(p_{i+2})) with cyclic indices; x_i=m s_i/p_i. Sum shares1, homogeneous0 in(p,m), positive demand and strictly negative own-price derivatives.
worked_cases.proof: At the anchor S=-P+(1/4)A, P=I-11^T/3 and A=[[0,1,-1],[-1,0,1],[1,-1,0]]. Its rows/columns sum0 and z^TSz=-norm(Pz)^2, yet S12!=S21, so it is incompatible with smooth expenditure rationalization on that neighborhood. A condition on quadratic forms alone does not impose symmetry on a nonsymmetric matrix.

worked_cases.name: Build preferences from a valid unit-cost function
worked_cases.model: c(p)=2sqrt(p1p2)+p3, e(p,u)=u c(p); U(x)=min(sqrt(x1x2),x3). Prove the P4 infimum formula equals this U, or directly derive the same e via AM-GM and x3>=u.
worked_cases.lesson: Full-domain concavity, homogeneity and nonnegative gradient deliver a constructive sufficient result for this class. Exact compensated line integrals agree because a global potential exists; adding a price-independent constant keeps gradients but violates Euler/price homogeneity.

worked_cases.name: Two inputs, diminishing returns and net-supply signs
worked_cases.model: f(k,l)=(kl)^(1/4), k,l>=0; target q>=0; w1,w2>0. Conditional c=2q^2sqrt(w1w2), k=q^2sqrt(w2/w1), l=q^2sqrt(w1/w2). With output price r>=0, q*=r/(4sqrt(w1w2)), pi=r^2/(8sqrt(w1w2)). Complete the output square for global optimality and prove conditional AM-GM bound.
worked_cases.proof: For perturbations a=dw1/w1,b=dw2/w2,rho=dr/r at r>0, quadratic profit curvature equals pi[2(rho-(a+b)/2)^2+(a-b)^2/4]. This gives PSD and the common-scale null direction. Conditional input derivatives have positive sign; profit net-input derivatives have negative sign.

worked_cases.name: Entry, capacity and the technology hidden by profits
worked_cases.model: One input with price w>0 and output with price r>0. Compact generating set K={(0,0)} union {(-4-q^2,q):0<=q<=3}; Y=K-R_+^2. Inactivity is feasible. Conditional cost in input units is0 atq0,4+q^2 for0<q<=3, and infinity above3.
worked_cases.branches: If r/w<4 choose0; at4 choose inactive orq2; for4<r/w<6 chooseq=r/(2w); forr/w>=6 chooseq3 (same uniqueq at6). Profit branches0, r^2/(4w)-4w, 3r-13w with the corresponding thresholds.
worked_cases.proof: At entry r=4,w=1, net supply is{(0,0),(-8,2)}, while convexification includes every connecting mixture. The point(-4,1) is infeasible in the original technology since one output requires5 inputs. Both technologies have identical profit at every positive price. Price1-sided output derivatives at entry are0 and2; at capacity the value is differentiable but second derivatives change.

exercises.task: Prove P1 with complete target/attainment restrictions and diagnose target1 under u(x)=1-exp(-sum x).
exercises.answer: Target1 is unattainable at every finite bundle; expenditure infimum over empty feasible set is+infinity with no Hicksian demand. Finite dual identities require an attainable target, not merely target>=u(0).

exercises.task: Referee a claim that budget/homogeneity/own-price signs prove global rationality, every monotone utility supports Roy division, and all observed profit values uniquely recover a nonconvex technology.
exercises.answer: Three major errors need explicit counterexamples W3,W2,W6; give corrected theorem hypotheses, identify which empirical support or extra convexity assumption could change each conclusion, and separate finite observed-price agreement from a proved full-price identity. Grade specific law/derivation/evidence and a defensible revised claim, not agreement with an opinion.

independent_numeric_audit.method: Root exact Fraction reconstructions from original primitive cases, analytic AM-GM/completed-square/Hessian and separation proofs; no source numerical oracle.

production_requirements: At least six fully worked cases and all twelve complete solutions, definitions/prerequisites, intuition plus proofs, explicit counterexamples, answered teach-back/retention, sources and truthful source scope. Four-file working manuscript/checker/source/author format; new author must independently rederive original anchors. No canonical promotion before C01 acceptance or V12 complete-volume publication.
